Hana P (Finance): Quick alert - Sentinel Systems invoice S-440 failed auto-pay this AM. Stripe shows decline_code: insufficient_funds.
Luis M (BillingOps): Pulling it up. Card on file ends 3055, exp 02/27. No backup. Customer on annual plan; churn risk if access cut.
Zoe T (CS): I just called their AP. They say payroll delay and will push funds tomorrow, asked if we can retry sooner.
payments-bot: Event posted: payment_intent.payment_failed {code: insufficient_funds, amount: 450000} (logged)
Luis M (BillingOps): Proposed: run 2 retries at 12h, send one-time secure pay link, allow 36h grace. If unpaid after 36h, restrict new deployments but keep existing infra running.
Hana P (Finance): Approved for 36h grace for this account. Add note to invoice S-440: "grace 36h - customer promised next-day payment". Do not escalate to collections yet.
Zoe T (CS): I'll email secure link and ask them to confirm when payment is sent. Also asked if they can add a backup card for future.
Luis M (BillingOps): Done: scheduled retries, updated invoice status to "pending - retry scheduled" and added internal note.
Hana P (Finance): Thanks. If payment not received by 36h, escalate to me and we'll prepare a short service restriction notice. :thumbsup:
